sql_prepared.part_orders:
INSERT INTO public.part_orders (
  organization_id,
  machine_id,
  created_by,
  status,
  notes,
  created_at,
  updated_at
) VALUES (
  (SELECT organization_id FROM public.users WHERE id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1),
  (SELECT id FROM public.machines WHERE name = 'VB750' LIMIT 1),
  auth.uid(),
  'draft',
  'Initial VB750 parts procurement from canonical truth dataset',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
) RETURNING id AS order_id;
